C_COD_CREDITED_DEFECTS.rationale: The candidate reports both remaining defects (an empty coupon_codes list triggering an IndexError and an unknown account_tier triggering a KeyError on DISCOUNT_BY_TIER), along with the specific inputs triggering them.

C_COD_FURTHER_PROBLEMS.rationale: The candidate identifies a real additional defect beyond the required calls: the function only inspects coupon_codes[0] despite accepting a list and naming the variable coupon_sum. It explains why this matters: extra valid coupons are ignored, causing buyers attempting to stack codes to overpay.

C_COD_WHO_IS_AFFECTED.rationale: The candidate clearly identifies who loses the money (the merchant loses/eats the difference while buyers are undercharged), exceeding Level 3. However, it does not clearly contrast the negative and zero totals to note that zero fails silently while negative amounts raise/fail at the payment layer, falling just short of Level 5.
